title: Shelf count drop can insert the tile inside the row
detail:
Shelf count drop can insert the tile inside the row

When p23 stays visible because it is waiting and p22 folds, the trailing count draws the drop marker after p23 but sends a move to the right of p22. The leading side mirrors the mismatch. Existing all-idle wire tests cover the row-end behavior. Match the row-end anchor to the marked position while keeping the waiting entries and count visible. Evidence is on s-b994gm, including the native wire reproduction.
